description: Manage organization team members, roles, invites, and extra user seats: list_members (retrieve users with current roles and seat limits), update_role (admin/manager role check), invite_member (generate an invite link), and create_seat_checkout (admin-only Stripe payment link to add user slots).

brandIds.description: Optional brand IDs to scope an invited member

email.description: Email address to invite (required for invite_member)

memberId.description: Target member user ID (required for update_role)

quantity.description: Number of extra team seats for create_seat_checkout (default 1)

role.description: Target role for update_role or invite_member

name: wordflux_manage_team
